data.name: Veibyn's GunGame
data.detailed_description:
Veibyn's GunGame is a fast, chaotic arena shooter where every kill brings a new opportunity to become more powerful.

Instead of simply progressing through a list of weapons, kills allow you to choose between three random upgrades. Increase your fire rate, movement speed, damage, health, projectile count and more — then stack upgrades together to create increasingly ridiculous builds.

No two matches have to play the same way.

KILL. UPGRADE. REPEAT.

Every kill pushes your build further.

Choose one of three upgrades and decide how you want your fighter to evolve. Focus on raw damage, turn your weapon into a bullet-spewing machine, increase your mobility, stack additional projectiles, or combine upgrades into something completely chaotic.

Some rare upgrades can dramatically change how your build works.

By the end of a match, your simple starting weapon can become an absolute monster.

MULTIPLAYER ARENA BATTLES

Fight against other players in fast arena matches, invite friends using multiplayer codes, or jump into battle with bots filling the remaining slots.

Prefer playing alone?

Single-player matches let you fight entirely against bots while keeping the same upgrade-driven progression.

ZOMBIE SURVIVAL

Take on increasingly dangerous hordes in Zombie Survival.

Fight multiple zombie types, survive escalating waves and face powerful bosses as the match becomes progressively more difficult.

Build your character as you survive and work together to stay alive.

When a teammate falls, special upgrades can even give you the opportunity to bring them back into the fight.

The run ends when everyone is dead.

How long can you survive?

MULTIPLE ARENAS

Battle across a collection of arenas with completely different themes, including:

- Neon Circuit

- Toon Town

- Castle Siege

- Warehouse Wire

- Western Town

- Desert Pyramid

Maps can rotate between matches, keeping battles varied and unpredictable.

BUILD YOUR OWN CHAOS

There isn't one correct build.

Stack attack speed until your weapon barely stops firing.

Add more projectiles.

Increase your damage.

Become faster.

Become harder to kill.

Or combine everything and see how ridiculous your weapon can become.

Veibyn's GunGame is about starting small and becoming completely overpowered.

FEATURES

- Fast-paced arena shooter combat

- Upgrade choice after kills

- Three random upgrade choices

- Stackable upgrades

- Rare and powerful upgrades

- Multiple weapons

- Online multiplayer

- Invite-code multiplayer

- Single-player with bots

- Bots fill empty player slots

- Multiple rotating arenas

- Zombie Survival mode

- Multiple zombie types

- Boss encounters

- Revive mechanics

- Controller and keyboard & mouse support

- Builds that become increasingly chaotic as the match progresses

Enter the arena. Get the kill. Choose your upgrade. Break the game.

data.short_description: A fast-paced arena shooter where every kill makes you stronger. Stack powerful upgrades, create ridiculous builds, battle players and bots, and survive increasingly chaotic zombie hordes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mild fantasy violence. Players use various weapons to shoot other players, bots, and zombies. Hits may produce small blood effects. The violence is arcade-style and not realistic or graphic. There is no gore, dismemberment, or depiction of realistic injuries.
